answers.why: Abimelech ruled over Israel for three years.
The men of Israel saw Abimelech was dead and returned to their homes.
Tola arose after Abimelech to deliver Israel.
Tola judged Israel for twenty-three years.
Jair judged Israel for twenty-two years.
The LORD delivered Israel into enemy hands after the people served other gods.
The Ammonites crossed Jordan to fight against the tribe of Judah.
Benjamin is a tribal target of the Ammonite attack.
The Ammonites fought against the house of Ephraim alongside Judah and Benjamin.
Israel was greatly distressed by the Ammonite attacks on its tribes.
Israel's misery is that of the people who removed foreign gods and served the LORD.
The Ammonites made war against Israel.
The elders sought Jephthah to lead them while Ammon was fighting Israel.
Israel is the nation accused of taking territory after coming out of Egypt.
Jephthah denies that Israel took the lands of Moab and Ammon during the exodus journey.
Israel journeyed from Egypt through the wilderness to the Red Sea and Kadesh.
Israel sent messengers requesting passage through Edom during the wilderness journey.
Israel remained at Kadesh after its requests for passage were refused.
Israel sent messengers to Sihon during the nation's journey toward its territory.
Israel's request says 'Let us pass,' identifying the speakers as a collective.
Sihon refused to trust Israel to pass through his territory and gathered his army.
Sihon and his assembled people fought against Israel.
The LORD is called Israel's God while granting the nation victory over Sihon.
Sihon and his people were delivered into Israel's hand, and they defeated them.
Israel collectively possessed the Amorites' land after defeating Sihon.
